Phase 4 will prove these reports without launching a game.

proven_subset: D3D12_LOGIC_OP_XOR render-target execution and exact readback
Independent per-render-target XOR/AND logic operations with exact two-target readback
binary64 emulation arithmetic/IEEE-754/conversion/predicate/FMA readback
Pixel RasterizerOrderedByteAddressBuffer load/increment/store ordering with Metal raster_order_group(0)
D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS.risk: Output-merger logic operations are backed by exact XOR render/readback and an independent per-render-target XOR/AND readback. Metal's global logic-operation state is emulated with one target-write-mask pipeline variant per attachment and repeated draw encoding (with depth/stencil state-only replay); pixel shaders with UAV side effects remain fail-closed rather than duplicated. Binary64 is a typed bit-level emulation provider with an exact compute IEEE-754 matrix, not native Metal double ALU. The Metal raster_order_group provider is proven for bounded byte-address, structured-buffer, and typed-texture pixel shapes, while the public ROV report remains false until the complete ROV resource/stage/state matrix is closed; conservative rasterization is restricted to validated rasterizer descriptions.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS1.risk: WaveOps reporting must remain coupled to the 32-lane dispatch/readback corpus.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS3_WRITE_BUFFE.risk: Copy-queue timestamps are coalesced to the Metal command buffer GPU end time and resolved through a completion handler; write-immediate flags are coupled to exact default, marker-in, and marker-out GPU virtual-address readback coverage on direct, compute, and inlined bundle command lists.

D3D12_METAL_RAYTRACING_HARDWARE.risk: Metal hardware support is paired with the complete focused DXR acceleration-structure, state-object, shader-table, synchronization, direct/indirect dispatch, and mixed-geometry child-hit gate.

D3D12_DXR_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURES.risk: A twelve-geometry indexed/non-indexed triangle BLAS, one-AABB BLAS, behavior-proven BLAS clone, shifted triangle/AABB/TLAS refits, compacted-size query, traversed compact copy, process-scoped BLAS/TLAS serialization and deserialization through a copied opaque blob, a twelve-instance TLAS with exact serialized pointer list, source-resource release before deserialized-TLAS traversal, mask-isolated inline RayQuery hit, stable distinct export identifiers with the Metal Shader Converter local-sampler slot preserved at bytes 16-23 and private alias hashes isolated to bytes 24-31, filtered same-table multi-collection merging with renamed imports and invalid-export rejection, direct and indirect DispatchRays execution, executed base/grown hit-group records with associated local-root constant and mirrored SRV/UAV/CBV/sampler tables, renamed and indexed miss/callable table records, raygen/triangle-any-hit/closest-hit/procedural-intersection records, depth-2 recursive TraceRay, deterministic shader stack-size values, and configured pipeline stack-size retention prove foundational DXR execution; mixed triangle/AABB geometry within one BLAS, persistent cross-process serialized reconstruction, independently linked collection merging, new-library state-object growth and broader record-count/stride/local-data shader-table matrices remain gated.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS6.risk: The proof covers the 1x1/1x2/2x1/2x2/2x4/4x2/4x4 rate matrix, constant and nonconstant 8x8 R8_UINT images, independent-axis SUM/SUM, indexed and non-indexed draws, per-primitive SV_ShadingRate selection, 65x65 logical reconstruction including the trailing row/column, command-list reset/reuse, and viewport plus render-target array-index transport with exact two-slice readback. Metal rate maps use the fixed 16x16 D3D12 image-tile rule; unsupported image shapes and rates remain rejected.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS7.risk: Sampler feedback uses padded software maps with SIMD-cooperative locking; committed/placed resources, invalid descriptors, clear, min-mip, mip-region-used, arrays, encode/decode, contention, and all four HLSL write forms pass exact readback. Mesh Tier 1 is backed by AS/MS pipeline streams, stage resources, payloads, direct/indirect two-group DispatchMesh, layered depth/blend/wireframe/VRS-compatible state, render-target arrays, and exact PIPELINE_STATISTICS1 invocation/primitive readback. Unimplemented work-graph and video paths remain explicitly unsupported.

proven_subset: constant-image SUM/SUM independent-axis combination with exact 2x2 readback
D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS10.risk: VariableRateShadingSumCombinerSupported is backed by the constant-image SUM/SUM readback and the axis-wise saturation implementation. MeshShaderPerPrimitiveShadingRateSupported remains false until SV_ShadingRate output is translated and exercised in a mesh pipeline.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS11.risk: ResourceDescriptorHeap atomic64 uses the same software lock lowering as raw and typed resources. A directly-indexed heap add stress and add/and/or/xor/min/max/exchange/compare-exchange matrix pass exact readback; direct heap descriptors are rebound after ordinary root tables so heap indices retain D3D12 meaning.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS12.risk: Enhanced barriers close active Metal encoders and establish queue order through the command-queue shared event. The report is backed by global, buffer, and texture groups plus exact copy-destination to copy-source buffer readback. Relaxed casting is limited to explicitly declared Device10 castable formats and is backed by committed/placed R32_FLOAT-to-R32_UINT readback, a focused overlapping placed-resource alias switch from 1.0 to 2.0, cross-layout R8G8B8A8_UINT readback, mismatched-unit-size creation rejection, and rejection of an undeclared R32_SINT view.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS14.risk: Exact compute and graphics readbacks prove programmable offsets, GatherRaw, SampleCmpLevel, and writable MSAA across 2D/2D-array resources, DSV-attached graphics, sample counts 2/4/8, and R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, and R8G8B8A8_UNORM resolves. DXMT emulates writable UAV MSAA resources as private 2D-array slices with logical array slices expanded by the sample count; unsupported formats and invalid resource shapes remain rejected.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS8.risk: The support report is backed by creation and upload/readback of a 7x5 BC1 texture with exact two-row block payload validation.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS9.risk: Native Metal atomic_ulong remains insufficient. DXMT serializes 64-bit atomic critical sections through 32-bit Metal locks, uses SIMD-cooperative lane selection to avoid same-SIMD spinlock deadlock, and proves 64-thread add stress plus unsigned/signed operation and compare-exchange matrices for typed resources and group-shared memory.

D3D12_FEATURE_LEVEL_12_2_TARGET.risk: The aggregate feature-level probe now creates every requested level, rejects unknown levels, and verifies the complete promoted capability set before this target is used.

D3D12_FEATURE_FEATURE_LEVELS.risk: The report is derived from the configured behavior-backed maximum and is checked together with the SM6.7 and FL12_2 option matrix.

D3D12_FEATURE_SHADER_MODEL.risk: SM 6.7 is behavior-backed by the SM 6.6 root-constant, descriptor-indexing, 64-bit, atomic/barrier, and texture/sampler runtime corpus plus SM 6.7 QuadAny/QuadAll dispatch/readback. Compute-stage programmable offsets, GatherRaw, SampleCmpLevel, and the promoted writable-MSAA format/sample-count matrix also pass exact readback.

D3D12_SYNTHETIC_SHADER_CORPUS.risk: Game captures must remain diagnostic; shader support claims require synthetic corpus coverage.
